&reftitle.parameters;
local_library_path
The local library directory, usually the same as the application.library.directory ini setting.
global_library_path
The global library directory. If not given, the local one is used.
&reftitle.returnvalues; The Yaf_Loader instance, or &false; if the loader has not been initialized (which is normally done by Yaf_Application).
